design.sampling: independent Poisson per port; lambda = total * PN / sum(PN)
design.normalization: observed counts / observed total * original PN sum; float32
design.zero_count: retain all-zero PN input; record explicitly; never retry
design.selection: all conditions fixed before measurement; no tuning or fitting
design.boundary: Abstract count observation noise on cached engineered actuator maps; not validated neural sampling, biological time windows, real fly data or semantic generalization.
